note: Frozen offline eval set drawn from reply_queue_events. Selection is a deterministic SQL rule (below) rather than a hardcoded id list: rows at or before `cutoff` never change, so the rule reproduces the same 361 cases forever. The runner asserts `strata` and `total` still match and fails loudly if they drift (rows deleted, bodies nulled, or the cutoff edited). No customer text is stored here - bodies are hydrated from the DB at run time.

rule.filter: suggested_body is not null and created_at <= cutoff
rule.order: row_number() over (partition by stratum order by md5(id::text))

paired.note: Has both suggested_body and final_body, so the human's sent text is the target.

reject.note: suggested_body only - nothing was sent, so there is no target text. Scored on whether retrieval should have abstained rather than on similarity.
